name: GlucoFM-Bench
description: From-scratch replication of GlucoFM-Bench (arXiv:2606.06881) — benchmarking time-series foundation models, TS-LLMs and deep-learning   baselines for short-term CGM glucose forecasting. Zero-/few-/full-shot protocols, RMSE/MAE + Clarke error grid, on the open AZT1D and Shanghai datasets.
